header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation is received. This
body: petition was filed in the year 2019 and lastly fixed in Court on 22.01.2019. Thereafter, no efforts were made to proceed with the matter. The prayer clauses of petition reveal that petitioner has challenged election of Pakistan Para-medical Association, Federation of Pakistan. It further reveals that subsequently several other elections were conducted. In view of the above, the instant petition being infructuous stands disposed of.
